title: RNA 5-Methylcytosine (m5C) in Cancer: An Emerging Epitranscriptomic Hub for Therapy Resistance and Clinical Translation.
snippet: RNA 5-methylcytosine (m5C) has emerged as an important epitranscriptomic modification in cancer. Rather than acting as a uniformly oncogenic mark, m5C produces context-dependent effects by coupling RNA fate to cellular adaptation.
